text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text:
Ah, damn it. The smell's completely soaked 
in...

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text:
Those guys are taking things way too far 
in the back alleys just because there's 
barely any foot traffic.

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text:
"If the other me starts wearing a scent 
she's not used to, she's bound to notice 
something's up..."

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text:
Grilling all that smoky stuff without a 
care... That back-alley robatayaki place 
is my secret spot, damn it, I don't want 
people finding out about it...!
